name: RBS Ranker for Target Promoter
description: Ranks RBS sequences in the characterized Kosuri library for an E. coli promoter by predicted Kosuri prot target. If tss_best is absent, first ask once whether the user has an experimentally measured value for a matching construct context (integer offset from the promoter/RBS junction). Use it if supplied; if none, unknown, or the user wants to proceed, omit it and continue without TSS-derived RNA accessibility features. Do not infer or invent a measured TSS, and do not repeat the question after it has been answered for this context. Rankings are candidate prioritization, not absolute protein concentrations.
